— 200
Returned if Tenable MSSP Portal successfully assigns the specified logo to the specified account(s).
400
Returned if your request specifies an invalid logo_uuid  or account_uuids  query parameter
value.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
500 Returned if an internal error occurred in the Tenable MSSP Portal.
